definitions.gloss: to face; to front on; to look out on
definitions.explanation: Describes a building, room, or area that faces or looks out onto a street, body of water, or other geographical feature.

examples.japanese: この{部屋|へや}は{海|うみ}に{面|めん}している。
{大通|おおどお}りに{面|めん}したカフェで{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせた。
examples.english: We met at a café facing the main street.

examples.japanese: {南|みなみ}に{面|めん}した{窓|まど}からは{日|ひ}が{差|さ}し{込|こ}んで{明|あか}るい。
examples.english: Light streams in through the south-facing window, making it bright.

notes:
{面|めん}する is an intransitive suru-verb meaning to face or look out onto something.

PARTICLE PATTERN:
- [place]に{面|めん}する — to face [place]

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海|うみ}に{面|めん}する (face the sea)
- {通|とお}りに{面|めん}する (face a street)
- {南|みなみ}に{面|めん}する (face south)
- {庭|にわ}に{面|めん}する (face the garden)

Often used in the ている form to describe a fixed orientation: この{家|いえ}は{公園|こうえん}に{面|めん}している (This house faces the park). Also common as a modifier: {海|うみ}に{面|めん}した{町|まち} (a town facing the sea).
